operator.scope: owned child processes only; explicit pre-signal status, SIGINT bracket, exit code and forced-kill outcome; not internal crash-cause attribution

robot.scope: owned child processes only; explicit pre-signal status, SIGINT bracket, exit code and forced-kill outcome; not internal crash-cause attribution

detail_schema.session_action: bit flags: close control 1, close sensor 2, flush samples 4; value=SessionError
detail_schema.link_lost: channel 0 CONTROL / 1 SENSOR; value=reason-specific socket state, provider error, epoll flags or wire error

sender_trace.scope: local lossy observations only; no replay/execution/absence authority; sequence order across producers is not causal order; provider_sent is SDK acceptance, not delivery

crash.scope: real ROS worker/bridge restart, external simulator persists; no accepted-command replay, original deadline and unresolved UNKNOWN retained; no physical-device outcome proof
